description: This file implements the DraftService class which manages the lifecycle of draft data product packages, including creation, retrieval, and listing of drafts. It interacts with a database and an audit service to handle draft data and record audit events.

classes.name: DraftService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to create, retrieve, and list draft data product packages.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_draft( self, package: Dict[str, Any], actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Creates a new draft data product package, assigning versioning if not provided, and records an audit event.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_draft(self, draft_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a draft by its ID, including parsing the stored JSON package data.

methods.name: list list_drafts(self, user_id: str = None)
methods.description: Lists all drafts, optionally filtered by user ID, ordered by creation time.

ctags.name: create_draft
ctags.signature: ( self, package: Dict[str, Any], actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )

ctags.name: get_draft
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_draft(self, draft_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: list_drafts
ctags.pattern: /^    def list_drafts(self, user_id: str = None) -> list:$/
